metadata.act_name: THE EXECUTION OF THE PUNISHMENT OF WHIPPING ORDINANCE, 1979

text:
1. Short title, extent, application and commencement.—(1) This Ordinance may be called the Execution of the Punishment of Whipping Ordinance, 1979.

(2) It extends to the whole of Pakistan.

(3) It applies to the execution of the punishment of whipping imposed under any law for the time being in force.

(4) It shall come into force on the twelfth day of Rabi-ul-Awwal, 1399 Hijri, that is, the tenth day of February, 1979.

4. Specifications of whip. The whip, excluding its handle, shall be of one single piece and preferably be made of leather, or a cane or a Branch of a tree, having no knob or joint on it, and its length and thickness shall not exceed 1.22 meters and 1.25 cm. respectively.

text:
6. Custody of convict pending execution of punishment, etc.—(1) In the case of a convict to whom only the punishment of whipping has been awarded, he shall until the execution of the punishment is completed, be dealt with as if sentenced to simple imprisonment.

(2) If, in the opinion of the authorized medical officer, a convict cannot, because of old age, ill-health or for any other reason, undergo the whole or any part of the punishment of whipping, the case shall be referred to the Court which may order the execution of the punishment in such manner as it may deem fit.

text: 7. Power to make rules. The Provincial Government may, by notification in the official Gazette, make rules for the purpose of carrying into effect the provisions of this Ordinance.
